rules.statement: A deed of revocation executed by the donor in 1904, which ceased to have any legal effect upon its execution, did not get overridden by a subsequent registered transfer made in 1916.
rules.supporting_quote: "When Mudalihamy revoked P2 in 1904, that deed ceased to have any legal effect That result was brought about by the mere fact of revocation and not by reason of any fact of registration."
